data.one_liner: A UI explorer and management tool for Hive databases.
data.what_it_does: Presents a visual interface to explore, view, edit, and create new rows inside Hive database boxes. It allows searching, deleting, and copying values directly from the app interface.
use_when: You are using the Hive database and need a visual interface to debug and manage stored data during development.
You need to quickly view, edit, or add rows to Hive boxes without writing custom admin screens.
avoid_when: You are not using Hive as your database solution.
You need production-grade end-user database management UIs that don't expose raw data structures.
strengths: Enables easy inspection and editing of Hive boxes.
Supports searching boxes by column name and value.
Cross-platform support across Android, iOS, Windows, macOS, and Linux.
weaknesses: Requires Hive to be installed with all boxes open and `toJson`/`fromJson` methods implemented.
Limited styling and layout configuration options.
data.setup_notes: Requires Hive to be set up, all target boxes open, and toJson/fromJson implemented on your Hive models.
